label: Variable-length integers
subgoals: Count one byte per group with a continuation bit
Sum the bytes over all values

label: Delta encoding sorted coordinates
subgoals: Sort the coordinates and keep the first value
Replace each later value by its difference from the previous
Compare the varint bytes of the deltas with fixed width

label: Zigzag encoding signed deltas
subgoals: Map nonnegative n to 2n and negative n to -2n - 1
Encode each mapped value as a varint
Sum the bytes, watching the 64 and 8192 boundaries
